title: Verify: validateWorld scene character reference unit tests
summary: Unit tests for NPC reference validation.
description: Add in-memory world objects to tests/content.test.ts and assert validateWorld errors.
acceptance_criteria: Each bad reference yields its error.
technical_constraints: Build LoadedWorld objects inline; no filesystem

steps.action: Add a helper building a world {id:'w',title:'W',startScene:'s',scenes:[scene],characters:[{id:'boy',name:'Boy'}],flags:['f']} where scene has dialogue [{id:'greet',speaker:'boy',text:'hi',choices:[]}] and a characters array passed per test. Test 1: character id 'ghost' -> errors contains 'unknown character: ghost'. Test 2: boy with interaction.dialogue 'nope' -> contains 'unknown dialogue: nope'. Test 3: interaction events [{type:'set_flag',flag:'zzz',value:true}] -> contains 'unknown flag: zzz'. Test 4: boy with dialogue 'greet' -> errors is [].
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/content.test.ts -t 'validateWorld scene characters'
